component.name: org.nuxeo.agentic.documents
component.documentation: Controlled documents: the number series packages contribute, and the numbers given from them by the platform's sequencer, the one the configuration property nuxeo.agentic.documents.sequencer names, or the platform's default. Each value is taken once and never given back, so a number is never reused, and a creation that rolls back leaves a gap.

extension-point.name: series
extension-point.documentation:
One number series.
id is capitals and digits, in parts joined by single hyphens, 32 characters at most. A number is the id, a hyphen, and the sequencer's value with leading zeros to digits, 1 to 12, 5 when not given: DWG-00042. revisions is letters (A, B ... Z, AA ...), the default, or numbers (1, 2, 3 ...). for is documents, the default, or transmittals: exactly one series in force numbers transmittals, and no document is numbered in it. A series with a mistake is left out, and logged as an error, so a document in it is refused. A later series with the same id replaces it whole, and enabled="false" removes it.
